# Essentials Folders

> Essentials Folders is a Zen Browser mod that turns the Essentials (pinboard) grid into folder tiles: nested folders, drag & drop, a search box for folders, and the mod's own settings dialog with 21 options. Tabs stay ordinary Zen tabs — the mod never moves or deletes anything. MIT licensed, works on Zen Browser 1.24b and newer.

## Start here

- [Essentials Folders — landing page](https://danonchek51.github.io/zen-essentials-folders/): what the mod does, how to install it, screenshots and answers to common questions.
- [English README](https://github.com/danonchek51/zen-essentials-folders/blob/main/README.en.md): the full English documentation.

## Installation

- [Sine Store](https://github.com/sineorg/store): маркетплейс модов Zen — найдите «Essentials Folders» и нажмите `Install`.
- [Install from repo](https://github.com/danonchek51/zen-essentials-folders): в Zen откройте `Sine Mods` → `Install from repo` и вставьте ссылку `https://github.com/danonchek51/zen-essentials-folders`, затем перезапустите Zen.

## Notes

- The mod is pure CSS and JavaScript for Zen Browser — no build step, no npm, no dependencies.
- The mod only draws: it adds its own tiles to the Essentials grid and never touches tabs or their data.
- Folders are stored in Zen preferences (`zen.essentialsfolders.*`), so they survive restarts and browser updates.
- Confirmed compatibility with the Zen Tab Groups mod (oom333).
- Author: danonchek51 — <https://github.com/danonchek51>.
